title: Spouse Employment Resources Available Through SpouseWorks
intro: Whether you are relocating to a new duty station, returning to the workforce, or looking to advance your professional journey, building a mobile career as a Marine Corps spouse comes with unique challenges.

sections.markdown:
The program formerly known as Spouse Education and Career Opportunities (SECO) has officially changed its name to [SpouseWorks](https://spouseworks.militaryonesource.mil/portal/). While the name is new, the commitment to Marine Corps spouses remains unchanged. SpouseWorks brings together all the trusted tools, financial resources, and career coaching you rely on into one unified, easy-to-use hub.

Marine Corps spouses can easily access these [SpouseWorks](https://spouseworks.militaryonesource.mil/portal/) tools online through the Family Member Employment Assistance Program (FMEAP) page on USMC-MCCS.org. The updated names bring clarity and streamlined navigation to the programs you already know:

- SpouseWorks Scholarship (formerly MyCAA): Eligible spouses can access up to $4,000 in tuition assistance for licenses, credentials, or associate degrees tied to portable career fields.
- SpouseWorks Fellowship (formerly Career Accelerator): Gain hands-on professional experience with paid or direct-placement opportunities hosted by partner employers.
- Military Spouse Employer Partnership (formerly MSEP): Connect directly with hundreds of companies committed to recruiting, hiring, and advancing military spouse talent.
- SpouseWorks Career Coaching Support: Access free, one-on-one expert career coaching for resume reviews, interview prep, and personalized job search guidance.

FMEAP staff stand ready to help spouses continue their careers or find new opportunities. To date in FY26, FMEAP has conducted more than 12,150 one-on-one counseling sessions to help military families reach their professional goals and has hosted 111 networking events that have been attended by 11,115 people.

sections.heading: How SpouseWorks & FMEAP Work Together for You
sections.markdown:
You do not have to navigate your career search alone. Your local installation [Family Member Employment Assistance Program (FMEAP)](https://usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/family-member-employment-assistance-program) team acts as your on-the-ground advocate. While SpouseWorks connects you to nationwide employer networks and federal scholarship tools, your local FMEAP specialists provide personalized, local support:

- Local Installation Expertise: One-on-one career counseling, local employer connections and job leads, and local networking events tailored to your duty station.
- Hands-On Workshops: In-person guidance on federal resume writing, interview techniques, and career transition strategies.
- Seamless Tool Access: Quick access to national SpouseWorks resources directly from the [FMEAP webpage](https://usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/family-member-employment-assistance-program).

sections.heading: Ready to Get Started?
sections.markdown:
Taking the next step in your career or education is straightforward:

- Explore the Digital Portal: Visit the [FMEAP webpage](https://usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/family-member-employment-assistance-program) to access the full suite of SpouseWorks tools, scholarship eligibility checkers, and employer portals.
- Connect Locally: Contact your installation's FMEAP office to schedule a resume review or join an upcoming employment workshop.
